title: Over a Noetherian local ring of depth zero an injective map of finite free modules has a unit maximal minor
statement: Let $(R,\mathfrak m)$ be a Noetherian local ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] whose maximal ideal is an associated prime of $R$: there is $z\in R$ with $\{a\in R: az=0\}=\mathfrak m$. Let $n,p\ge0$ be integers and $A$ a $p\times n$ matrix with entries in $R$ [def-weil-matrix] such that the $R$-linear map $R^{\oplus n}\to R^{\oplus p}$, $v\mapsto Av$, between free modules [def-weil-pbc-free-module] is injective. Then $n\le p$, and some $n\times n$ minor of $A$, i.e. the determinant [def-weil-pbc-matrix-determinant] of the $n\times n$ submatrix [def-weil-submatrix] of $A$ formed by $n$ of its rows, is a unit of $R$ (for $n=0$ the empty minor is $1$). Equivalently, the ideal of $R$ generated by the $n\times n$ minors of $A$ is $R$.

source.place: Algebra, Lemma Tag 00MY (lemma-exact-depth-zero-local, line 24678) applied to the complex 0 -> R^n -> R^p (e = 1, exact at R^n), together with Lemma Tag 00MW (lemma-trivial-case-exact, line 24739) parts (1) and (3) (rank r_1 = n and I(phi_1) = R for a direct sum of trivial complexes) and Definition Tag 00MV (definition-rank, line 24722); the splitting is Lemma Tag 00MT (lemma-add-trivial-complex, line 24608). Tags verified in tags/tags: 00MY,algebra-lemma-exact-depth-zero-local; 00MW,algebra-lemma-trivial-case-exact; 00MV,algebra-definition-rank; 00MT,algebra-lemma-add-trivial-complex
